verdict.rationale: For a GPU accelerator, the relevant public API is its software stack. The pack documents the open-source HIP runtime and programming model, ROCm compute and communication libraries, the AMD SMI tool for managing and monitoring GPUs, a Prometheus-format metrics exporter and a Kubernetes GPU Operator, plus an llms.txt index for agents. The missing OpenAPI spec (probe-3) is expected, since this is not a web service. Missing for 10: the evidence is only one-line doc summaries with no actual API reference content, no explicit programmatic library API for AMD SMI is shown, there are no markdown doc variants (probe-2 returned 404), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the GPU via these APIs.
